meta.name: meta-tags-optimizer
meta.description: Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, Open Graph, and Twitter cards for maximum click-through rate. Generates multiple A/B test variations with character counting and SERP preview. Use when asked to "optimize title tag", "write meta description", "improve CTR", "Open Graph tags", "fix my meta tags", "social media preview", "my click rate is low", "title optimization", or any meta tag task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化网页标题和描述，提升搜索结果点击率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要提高网页在搜索引擎和社交平台的点击表现
copy.tagline_en: Optimize title tags and meta descriptions to boost click-through rate
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to improve click performance on search engines and social media

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能优化网页的标题标签、元描述、Open Graph 和 Twitter 卡片，生成多个 A/B 测试版本，并显示字符数和搜索结果预览。
howto.when: 当你要求优化标题标签、写元描述、改善点击率、处理 Open Graph 或 Twitter 卡片，或提到点击率低时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个页面的标题和元描述：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会分析页面并生成优化方案。

say.text: 为这篇关于如何开始播客的文章写元标签
改进这些元标签以提高点击率：当前标题：...
say.note: Claude 会提供 A/B 测试建议和 CTR 优化分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can optimize title tags, meta descriptions, Open Graph, and Twitter cards for web pages, generating multiple A/B test variations with character counting and SERP preview.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to optimize title tags, write meta descriptions, improve CTR, handle Open Graph or Twitter cards, or mention low click rates.

say_en.text: Optimize the title and meta description for this page: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the page and generate optimization suggestions.

say_en.text: Create meta tags for a blog post about how to start a podcast
say_en.note: Claude will create a complete meta tag block including OG and Twitter cards.

say_en.text: Improve these meta tags for better CTR: current title: ...
say_en.note: Claude will provide A/B test suggestions and CTR optimization analysis.
